To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a) a new event queue mechanism can enable efficient instruction-level simulation of microcontroller-based sensor network applications, and b) the event queue mechanism enables the extraction of the hidden parallelism inherent in fine-grained sensor network simulations.

(1) the event queue can enable instruction level simulation of sensor networks with cycle accuracy; (2) a new synchronization mechanism, the event barrier, can be used to synchronize multiple threads of execution; (3) the event queue and event barrier together enable the extraction of parallelism from sensor network simulations; (4) Avrora can simulate networks of up to several thousand nodes with cycle accuracy, 20 times faster and with more accurate time measurement than previous simulators.
We present Avrora: a cycle accurate instruction-level sensor network simulator which performs up to 20 times faster and scales to up to 10K nodes.
